topic: Principles of Holography and Diffraction: Capturing Light in 3D

sections.title: Prerequisite: The Nature of Wave Interference
lecture_lines: Light waves carry both amplitude and phase.
Coherent lasers maintain constant phase relationships.
Wave superposition creates unique interference patterns.
animations: Show two identical sine-waves, one above the other, moving left to right. (Color: #FFFF00)
Constructively combine waves to increase amplitude peak. (Color: #00FF00)
Destructively combine waves to create a flat line, showing interference. (Color: #FF0000)

sections.title: Diffraction: How Light Bends and Encodes
lecture_lines: Waves bend around obstacles called diffraction.
Holograms act as complex diffraction gratings.
animations: Light waves pass through a narrow slit, spreading outward into a curve. (Color: #FFFFFF)
Display a grid representing a complex diffraction grating on a plate. (Color: #00FFFF)
Light hits the grid, and wave fronts reconstruct behind the plate. (Color: #FFFF00)

sections.title: The Holographic Recording Process
lecture_lines: Reference beam provides a stable baseline.
Object beam reflects light from the target.
Film records these intricate microscopic fringes.
animations: Laser beam splits into two paths: Reference (B) and Object (A). (Color: #FF0000)
Beam (A) bounces off an object, changing its phase based on shape. (Color: #FF0000)
Beam (B) travels directly to the recording plate. (Color: #FF0000)
Beams (A) and (B) meet at the plate, forming interference fringes. (Color: #00FF00)
A final holographic recording plate appears with fringe patterns. (Color: #FFFFFF)

sections.title: Reconstruction: Decoding the 3D Image
lecture_lines: Reference beam illuminates the recorded hologram.
Diffraction pattern bends the light beam.
Original wavefronts emerge from the plate.
We perceive the object in space.
animations: Reference beam hits the recorded holographic plate. (Color: #FFFF00)
Light diffracts as it passes through the fringe patterns. (Color: #00FF00)
Diffracted light forms a 3D virtual image of the original object. (Color: #FFFFFF)
An icon of an eye shifts perspective, revealing different sides of the object. (Color: #00FFFF)
The object glows in 3D space, showing depth and detail. (Color: #FF00FF)

sections.title: Summary and Real-World Application
lecture_lines: Interference captures phase and amplitude information.
Diffraction restores the original light field.
animations: Animate a flow showing recording, storage, and reconstruction. (Color: #FFFFFF)
A stylized data cube pulsates, storing light phase patterns. (Color: #00FFFF)
A microscope beam interacts with a sample, capturing light fields. (Color: #FFFF00)
